notes: OCR reliability: a failed Tesseract engine load (typically no internet on first use) used to fail completely silently -- the document still saved but with no auto-detected type/plate/driver and no explanation shown to the user. Now surfaced as an explicit warning toast, and the record carries an ocr_engine_failed flag so this is distinguishable from a genuine no-text image. Also includes 1.61.5 (driver-document linking fix) and 1.61.4 (Firebase auto-sync fix).
